decisions.reason: The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes Big Block references from the FAQ and reflects the $5 founder, affiliate, and Small Block allocations.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already restricts secondary-sale prize-pool proceeds to Small Block while leaving the unaffected royalty amount and founder secondary-sale share unchanged.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes the Big Block ticket from the no-referral reward components and preserves the commission and Small Block ticket.

The existing MODIFY correctly removes Big Block content but also changes reward collection and drops the established Small Block cadence without support from message 195; the corrected value preserves unaffected copy.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey Joseph, id like to eliminate the big blocks and give that extra $1 to me, so it'll be:
$15 buy, $5 to me,  $5 to affiliate,  $5 to block prize pool.

Increases my bottom line with minimal impact on sales.
Plus it simplifies the game mechanics and marketing.

Giveing myself and each community member an even split, as well as everyone getting an even shot at the never ending $500 prizes seems aligned with the projects ethos.

how_it_works_copy.mint: Purchase the ebook NFT for $15 USD; the mint number is the referral code.
how_it_works_copy.referrals: Sharing the mint number or link earns an instant $5 USD for each referred mint, with no limit or expiration; when no code is used, the commission and Small Block ticket go to a random existing ticket holder.
how_it_works_copy.tickets: Each referral gives a Small Block prize ticket for the current block, and more referrals provide more chances to win.
how_it_works_copy.prizes: Small Block awards 1 × $500 every 100 sales, counting mint and secondary sales, with winners selected through Chainlink VRF; do not describe a Big Block prize.
how_it_works_copy.reward_collection: Commissions are sent automatically on-chain, while prize wins are announced on the Winners page and claimed with one click.

decisions.reason: Changing primary-mint revenue allocation and eliminating Big Block does not alter the Transak provider, payment methods, conversion, or purchase-fulfillment behavior.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes Big Block from the mission-page prize copy while retaining the continuing Small Block prizes.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already records the new $5 primary-mint contribution to the remaining Small Block prize pool; the Small Block amount and cadence are otherwise unchanged.
The allocation change does not alter whether tipping is enabled, its placement, preset amounts, or custom-tip support.
The wallet still holds and exposes prizes generally after Big Block elimination, so wallet provisioning, assets, confirmation, access, and cashout guidance remain valid unchanged.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already restricts ticket awards and counters to Small Block and deletes the obsolete Big Block eligibility and post-draw keys.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes Big Block eligibility and scope while preserving the still-valid Small Block Chainlink VRF selection behavior.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already deletes the obsolete Big Block ticket-counter metadata key while preserving Small Block and badge metadata.
